name: Blitzball water sphere look v2 (definitive)
coordinate_notes: r = distance from sphere centre in screen space / screen radius. f = 1 - dot(N, V) (fresnel). For an orthographic-ish view r = sqrt(1 - (1-f)^2).

body.mode: background seen through the sphere, inverted and minified like a lens, then posterized to the body LUT
body.lens_note: sample background at centre + (p - centre) * lens_scale (negative = inverted). Use +0.85 for gameplay so swimmers are not upside down.
body.step_formula: k = 1 + floor(luma(bg) * 3.4); if (screen_ny > 0.35) k -= 1; k = clamp(k, 0, 4); colour = body_lut[k]
body.fallback_no_refraction: k = 2 (base) + 1 above ny<-0.3, -1 below ny>0.35; one constant alpha quantized to 0.25 steps (uFallbackBlend=1, default) or a Bayer screen-door at body_opacity (uFallbackBlend=0); rim, web and highlight stay solid

caustic_web.node_rings: rings of 1 px around each 3-cell junction (the bright knot cores are left empty, so they read as rings)
caustic_web.screen_scale_in_mock: 1 tile texel = 1 mock pixel; tile = 2.56 sphere radii

halo.geometry: expanded shell, radius x 1.07; analytic ring outside the true radius

dither.rule: pixel on if (bayer[y%4][x%4] + 0.5) / 16 < coverage  (texture: bayer4_4x4.png, value/255)
dither.note: aligned to the virtual pixel grid, not world space

highlight.decal: highlight_decal_128.png (whole-disc decal, cutout, for sprite fallbacks)

bubbles.sheet: bubbles_64.png (the exact sprites pasted into the mock)

inside_view.fog_steps_m: radius x [0.9, 1.5, 2.0] (13.5 / 22.5 / 30 m at R=15; v1 used 6/14/26 for a much smaller sphere)
inside_view.background: posterized toward water_3..water_6 by luma when refraction is on

transparency.rule: no smooth alpha anywhere. Outside: opaque refracted body. Fallback: Bayer screen-door at body_opacity. Halo: Bayer cutout.

pixel_grid.game_default: render the whole scene at 1/3 resolution with nearest upscale, or set uPixel = 3 (shader snaps to a 3 px virtual grid)
pixel_grid.world_texel_option: 32 px/m snap for the caustic web (uWebTexelsPerM)

extra_tones_not_in_v2.#2A9EAE: aqua_mid: teal-to-cyan step between water #2A8CC4/dye_teal #2E8A84 and #3EB8D8
extra_tones_not_in_v2.#5ED2DC: aqua_bright: crystal + caustic core step between #3EB8D8 and #8CE6E8
extra_tones_not_in_v2.#BDF6F0: rim_glow: sphere rim glow / crystal hot core, between #8CE6E8 and #E8FFF6
